errors.evidence: The categories on the horizontal axis are not in alphabetical order; they are sorted in descending order based on the value of the corresponding bar.
The list of categories is incomplete. It omits 'Прекъсване на конкуренцията / пазара' (which should be 4th) and 'Насилие на работното място' (which should be 16th).
The chart label is 'Интегриране на продукта' (Integration of the product), not 'Интегриране на работното място' (Integration of the workplace).
The chart shows that the values for 'Правни / регулаторни' and 'Киберпрестъпления' are both approximately 16%, not 20%. The bar at 20% corresponds to the 'Неизправност' category.
The bar for 'Тероризъм' is at approximately 7%, not 'около 5%' (around 5%). Only the 'Други' category is at 5%.
